interface.shortDescription: B2B prospecting via Landbase agents and the landbase-cli binary.
interface.longDescription: Search Landbase's B2B database in natural language, refine results across multi-turn sessions, manage your API key, and install or verify the landbase-cli binary — all from inside Codex CLI. The plugin wraps the public landbase-cli contract (stdout=JSON, documented error codes) and bundles the full Landbase API skill for raw-API workflows (upload, onboard, match, enrich, publish).
